items.title: 24.3.2 Primary, secondary aur tertiary amines ki pehchan (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of distinguishing amines with nitrous acid (PDF 123-124).

blocks.text: Primary, secondary aur tertiary aliphatic amines nitrous acid (nitric(III) acid), HNO2, ke saath reactions se pehchani jati hain. Nitrous acid na-mustahkam hai, is liye sodium nitrite aur hydrochloric acid se mixture mein hi banaya jata hai: NaNO2 + HCl -> HNO2 + NaCl.

items: Primary amines diazonium namak banati hain (diazotisation): CH3CH2NH2 + HNO2 + HCl -> CH3CH2N2+ Cl- + 2H2O. Aliphatic diazonium namak itne na-mustahkam hain ke fauran toot kar nitrogen gas dete hain, jo bulbulon ki shakal mein dikhti hai.
Secondary amines N-nitrosoamines, peele tel jaise maaye, banati hain: CH3CH2NHCH3 + HNO2 -> CH3CH2N(CH3)-N=O + H2O (N-methyl-N-nitrosoethanamine).
Tertiary amines react kar ke ghulne wala nitrite namak banati hain, reaction ka koi nazar aane wala nishan nahi: CH3CH2N(CH3)2 + HNO2 -> [CH3CH2NH(CH3)2]+ NO2- (N,N-dimethylethanammonium nitrite).

blocks.alt: Oopar: NaNO2 + HCl -> HNO2 + NaCl, thanda. Phir teen panel: primary, CH3CH2NH2 + HNO2 + HCl se CH3CH2N2+ Cl- + 2H2O, jo fauran toot kar N2 (bulbule) deta; secondary, CH3CH2NHCH3 + HNO2 se CH3CH2N(CH3)-N=O + H2O (peela tel jaisa maaye); tertiary, CH3CH2N(CH3)2 + HNO2 se [CH3CH2NH(CH3)2]+ NO2- (koi nazar aane wali tabdeeli nahi).
blocks.caption: Nitrous acid ke saath primary, secondary aur tertiary amines (kitab ke mua'adlon ka asal khulasa).
blocks.long_description: Amines ki teen qismein nitrous acid ke saath teen mukhtalif nataij deti hain: primary aliphatic amine ke liye nitrogen ke bulbule, secondary amine ke liye peela tel, aur tertiary amine ke liye koi nazar aane wali tabdeeli nahi, jo bas ghulne wala namak banati hai.

blocks.prompt: Phenylamine (Kb 4.2 x 10^-10) cyclohexylamine (Kb 3.3 x 10^-4) se taqreeban das lakh guna kam basic kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Phenylamine mein nitrogen ka lone pair benzene ring mein delocalised hai, is liye proton lene ke liye kaheen kam dastiyab hai; cyclohexylamine ka ring saturated hai, is liye lone pair nitrogen par rehta aur alkyl ring us ki taraf electrons dhakelta hai.

blocks.prompt: Kaun zyada basic hai, ethanamine ya propan-2-amine? Wajah batayein.
blocks.explanation: Kitab ke inductive usool se propan-2-amine thora zyada basic hona chahiye: is ke nitrogen se jure carbon par do methyl groups hain jo nitrogen ki taraf zyada electron density dhakelte hain. Paani mein napi qeematein taqreeban barabar hain (dono ka pKb taqreeban 3.3), kyunke ions ki solvation bhi asar karti hai.

blocks.prompt: Propan-2-amine ka HCl se reaction dikhayein aur namak ka naam batayein.
Machhli ko sirke se treat karne par kaun sa tezaab trimethylamine se react karta hai? Mua'adla likhein.
blocks.explanation: Ethanoic acid: (CH3)3N + CH3COOH -> (CH3)3NH+ CH3COO- (trimethylammonium ethanoate, jis ki boo nahi).

items: Primary: N2 ke bulbule; secondary: peela tel jaisa N-nitrosoamine; tertiary: ghulne wala namak, koi tabdeeli nahi.
